description:
A STEP download URL for the part (millimetres), to import into SolidWorks, Fusion, Onshape, FreeCAD or Cliff,
    with its attribution. Geometry is nominal; threads are not modeled. Saved to this computer, its `path` returned, unless save_to is ''.

save_to.description: A folder on this computer to save the file in (default: CLIFF_MCP_DOWNLOADS, else ~/Downloads/Cliff). Set save_to to an empty string to only get the link.

name: get_cad
